content: Tesseract degrades badly on small, stylized, anti-aliased screen text. It expects ~300dpi non-anti-aliased input; screen text is ~72dpi and anti-aliased. Key technique (stb-tester): UPSCALE BEFORE THRESHOLDING so anti-aliasing information survives to outline extraction — error rate dropped 8.3% -> 1.2%. Additional levers: binarization/high contrast, isolating the glyph region from graphical backgrounds, restricting the character whitelist (tessedit_char_whitelist), using PSM 7/8 (single line/word) instead of full-page segmentation, and training a custom traineddata for highly stylized fonts. Without preprocessing, expect confusions among visually similar glyphs (I/l/1, O/0, rn/m, 5/S).
